Maya Chen: Hey team — opening a docs PR for on-prem install FAQ + new code examples for KMS/HSM network quirks. PR: https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/5123
Samir Rao: Thanks Maya. Can you paste the minimal nftables example here? I'm testing in a sealed-site env.
Maya Chen: Sure — minimal snippet I used:
```
# allow KMS TCP 5696 from installer host
-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 5696 -s 10.0.0.0/24 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
```
Leo Park: Looks good. Add note about MTU/path-mtu and TCP MSS clamping for encapsulated networks.
Aaron Patel: Also one quick link fix — the HSM PKCS11 driver link currently 404s in the PR. I can update to the new S3 link.
Maya Chen: Thanks. @Aaron can you push that as a follow-up commit? I'll also add an FAQ Q about offline time sync.
Aaron Patel: Yep, will do. Also suggest adding a tiny `conn-checker` command example:
`./conn-checker --host kms.local --port 5696 --protocol tcp`
Docs Bot: link-check passed on commit 1, but broken link flagged in docs/install/hsm.md: line 42
Samir Rao: I'll review the HSM section and verify the PKCS11 config sample. Can someone add which distro(s) we tested on?
Maya Chen: Tested on Ubuntu 22.04 and RHEL 8.7 — I'll add that. Plan: Aaron fixes link, Samir reviews HSM snippets, Leo adds MTU note, then we can merge. Any blockers?
Leo Park: None from my side. :thumbsup:
Aaron Patel: Push incoming in ~15m. :shipit:
Maya Chen: Awesome — thanks all. Will request 2 approvals after Aaron's commit.
